Dear Sir Leslie Brash, 2.5.24. I am more sorry than I can say to hear of the loss of your mare and for my unlucky part in the matter. Dear Sir Leslie Brash, S.S.24. I saw Mr. Grigblay to-day. He is willing to renew his tender, and I am meeting him to-morrow at the quantity surveyor's to see what reductions can be made in the matters I proposed to you. I will write to you to-morrow or call in the afternoon. Yours sincerely, SPINLOV

Dear Sir, 22.5.24. Our foreman, Bloggs, who is setting out house, has informed us that dimensions on plan do not work out correct.
